name: Sofa, Roche Bobois Script 240, large 3-seater, armrest left

clearance.note: Legroom in front of the seat; a coffee table can stand 45 cm away

notes: Roche Bobois Script (design Sacha Lakic), module 38: "Grand bâtard 3 places gauche", the large 3-seat 1-arm unit with its armrest on the LEFT as you face it (x < 0; on the right of someone sitting on it), 240 cm. Sizes from Roche Bobois's technical sheet (technicals.roche-bobois.com/M191834697/TDSv_SCRIPT_2026.pdf, pages 2–3): 240 wide, 121 deep, 85 high, seat height 43, feet 4 high; the armrest 51 wide: not a raised arm but three square cushions at the seat's height, an open end to sit or put things on; the two back cushions, 92 wide with their 79 wide lumbar cushions, stand over the four seat segments to its right, the seat 56 deep in front of them. Roche Bobois also makes it with the armrest on the right (module 37), which this item is not; the app can't mirror an item. Shown with the backs closed, their normal position: each back cushion sits on a rocking mechanism that opens it 27 cm further back (148 deep overall), and the planner shows the one position, so plan for the 121 cm and leave room behind to open the backs. model.glb is generated by `npx tsx tools/models/roche-bobois-script.ts` from its own geometry after the sheet's drawings and Roche Bobois's photos: a low base of four segments running from front to back beside the armrest, plump and domed with soft channels between them, the block behind the seat carrying the back cushions; two thick rounded back cushions leaning back, each with its lumbar roll; small square feet in wengé-stained beech, set well in. Roche Bobois makes Script only in its stretch fabrics (Bamboo, Chroma, Orsetto Flex, Passion, Pixel, Smile Flex, Techno 2D, 3D and 4D) and shows it in green Orsetto Flex; the fabrics here are planning colours, not Roche Bobois's, the default cream bouclé among them, as are the dark browns (fabric.espresso, fabric.dark-chocolate, fabric.dark-walnut, fabric.dark-umber). The seat and the armrest are surfaces, so cushions and throws can go on them.
